summary: Nothing new that changes Amazon's cash flows beyond the post-print update: its quarterly SEC report (10-Q, filed Oct 30) confirms the release (twelve-month free cash flow minus 42.4B, long-term debt 173.1B) and the research already ran a 10-Q pass today. Analysts mostly trimmed targets (Scotiabank 325 to 300, Cantor 310 to 280, Citizens 315 to 275) with a few raises, all at or above our research target (12m) of 269.55; the stock closed at 240.47 on Oct 30, down 1.4% and well above the after-hours low near 227.

items.headline: Amazon Form 10-Q for the quarter ended Sep 30, 2026 filed
items.why: I opened it. Twelve-month free cash flow is minus 42,357M (operating cash 168,300M less capex net 210,657M), long-term debt 173,125M, no buy-backs in 2026 (6.1B left on the program), and in October the 5B 364-day and 15B revolving credit lines were renewed unchanged in size (undrawn, routine). The FTC ad-auction case and the monopolization case are already in the research (the SOTP deducts them). The research logged its own 10-Q pass on Oct 30 (AWS equipment balance, interest on higher debt), so no new numbers.

items.headline: 10-Q legal note: Xockets patent case at the US International Trade Commission now also names AWS servers with GB300 chips (opened June 2026), injunction sought
items.why: Not in the research files. Nvidia and Microsoft are co-respondents and Amazon says it will defend. A ban on those servers would hit AWS capacity at whatever date a ruling lands; I could not size the chance or the date, so I count it as unsized risk, not a number.

items.headline: Analyst target changes after the print: Scotiabank 325 to 300, Cantor Fitzgerald 310 to 280, Citizens 315 to 275, TD Cowen 350 to 340, BofA 320 to 317; raises at Mizuho 335, UBS 352, MoffettNathanson 357
items.why: Two aggregators (MarketBeat and 24/7 Wall St) overlap only in part and the notes were not read, so the list stays unverified. Opinions inside the agents' range, no new facts. Every target is at or above our research target (12m) of 269.55.

items.headline: Amazon call: AWS growth above 40% projected for 2027 and 2028, 2027 capex 'meaningfully more' than 2026's about 220B, Prime Day shift cost about 4 points of Q3 growth
items.why: Already in the update round and the release (the research cites the Jassy quote from the release). Not new. No Anthropic or OpenAI news in the window.

items.headline: Amazon shares closed 240.47 on Oct 30 (-1.4%), after 243.79 on Oct 29 and 227.60 after hours; premarket dipped to about 226
items.why: Price move only; closes from the market data quote. The close is far above the 187 thesis break.
